snippet.title: Rumbly - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 Get ready to rumble!

Rumbly is a fast-paced turn-based roguelike where speed, precision, and momentum are everything. Chain combos, unleash powerful skills, and climb through 50 deadly floors!

🎮 Play the free demo soon on Steam during Next Fest!
🛒 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612210/Rumbly/
